fuel_consumption.source_quote: Based on our 2015 fuel consumption, a hypothetical ten percent increase in the average price per gallon of aircraft fuel would have increased fuel expense by approximately $27.8 million for the years ended December 31, 2015.

instrument_type_details.notes: Company states 'have not hedged fuel price risk in recent years'.

throughput.source_quote: Aircraft fuel expense for 2015 decreased $109.8 million, or 28.3 percent, compared with 2014. The decrease was primarily the result of a 38.2 percent decrease in system average cost per gallon. This was offset by a 16.3 percent increase in system fuel gallons consumed. [Derived: 128.9M × 1.163 = 150.0M gallons]
